rationale: The plan correctly identifies the interaction as full ~condition+time+condition:time vs reduced ~condition+time LRT in DESeq2, with time as a 4-level factor, t0 reference, and explicitly contrasts this against the main time and condition effects to quantify 'beyond the shared trend.' QC (library size, VST-PCA colored by condition/time, correlation heatmap) precedes testing with an explicit outlier policy implied via PCA checks, though no explicit shallow-sample removal rule is stated. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is standard and justified; normalization is correctly left inside DESeq2's model (size factors), not pre-normalized. FDR (padj<0.05) is stated with no post-hoc relaxation, and effect sizes are shrunk via lfcShrink/apeglm for the per-timepoint contrasts; thresholds are set in the test rather than after the fact. Enrichment is well-justified with GSEA/ORA, explicit universe (T1S1-filtered genes), named collections (Hallmark, GO-BP), and redundancy collapsing, comparing interaction vs shared-time gene sets as warranted; the report step names methods, thresholds, gene counts, and caveats (df, duplicates, power) thoroughly, though a small extra rigor gap remains around explicit alpha/version pinning for tools.
